test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

I have never played a hero before, so I jump at the chance.

options.text: So I jump at the chance

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in option 1 is the use of the present tense **"jump" **which should be in the past tense **"jumped" **as the sentence is describing past actions.
 
• In the first part of the sentence present perfect tense is used which **connects the past action to present action**.
 
 
• **For example:** I have never visited Paris before, so I seized the opportunity when it arises.
 
 
 
• The change is needed to maintain consistency with the first part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct sentence is-** *"I have never played a hero before, so I jumped at the chance."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 ("a hero before") **is grammatically correct as it properly modifies "played."
 
• **Option 3 ("I have never played")** uses the present perfect tense correctly to discuss an action that has not happened in someone's experience up to the present.
